scope_note: Developer-side system definition only. It binds no blind cohort, authorizes no run, and must not be cited as an evaluation freeze. prospective-blind-v3 stands at 8/12 and remains custodian-sealed.

execution_graph_unique.detail: docs/AGENT_V1_EXECUTION_GRAPH.md defines one graph, but two of its stages (llm_extractor, openai_responses_provider) are absent from this branch.

raw_llm_definition_unique.detail: Raw is defined as llm-extractor-v1 output. tools/run_trust_benchmark.py still labels the deterministic rule baseline 'raw'.

verifier_unique.detail: evidence-verifier-v1 is the formal verifier; the LLM verifier-v1 is DEFERRED_TO_V1_1. One open defect: normalization is invoked inside the verifier instead of being its own stage.

field_schema_frozen.detail: benchmark/FIELD_SCHEMA_V1.json, 12 atomic fields, no aggregate conditions field, selectivity option B.

scoring_contract_frozen.detail: benchmark/SCORING_CONTRACT_V1.md is frozen as a specification; no scorer implements it yet.

prompt_frozen.detail: llm-extractor-prompt-v1 exists only on the old freeze branch and its response schema covers 8 fields, not the 12 of FIELD_SCHEMA_V1.

model_frozen.detail: Model id gpt-5.6-sol, Responses API, strict JSON, reasoning effort medium, temperature and top_p null, seed unsupported. OpenAI SDK version unresolved.

runtime_captured.detail: requirements-benchmark-lock.txt pins the deterministic stack. The openai package is absent, and one interpreter version must be chosen for the benchmark environment.

cli_runnable.detail: agent.py extract-text, verify-text, benchmark and trust-benchmark run without an API key. No CLI path reaches a model.

regression_tests_pass.detail: Local suite green on synthetic fixtures and manifest invariants; no development-set or blind data is executed in CI.

blocking_gaps: port modules/llm_extractor.py and modules/openai_responses_provider.py to this branch
revise the extractor response schema from the 8 legacy fields to the 12 fields of FIELD_SCHEMA_V1, which creates llm-extractor-v2 and a new prompt version
move ligand normalization out of extraction_verifier.py into its own graph stage
implement a scorer that follows SCORING_CONTRACT_V1, keyed on candidate_id rather than list position
stop labelling the rule baseline 'raw' in tools/run_trust_benchmark.py
pin the OpenAI SDK version and one Python version for the benchmark environment
validation_data_used: benchmark manifests committed in this repository
